plain_language_scope: Record possible contamination for human review without removing any source from selector version 1 or the radial profile.

star_forming_region_or_young_cluster: Color may prioritize visual inspection but cannot assign the flag.
A yes flag requires a catalog association or visual evidence.
No catalog match provides no contrary evidence because catalogs are incomplete.
Uncertain evidence remains uncertain and does not become a rejection.
nearby_source_blend_or_image_problem: The final flag requires visual inspection of the cutout.
Gaia image measurements may prioritize inspection but remain separate.
An unusable image remains unusable rather than being labeled clean.

review_columns.name: star_forming_catalog_association
review_columns.meaning: Whether a published H II-region or young-cluster catalog contains the source. Not found does not count as contrary evidence because these catalogs are rare and incomplete; it remains unknown evidence.

review_columns.name: star_forming_color_review_priority
review_columns.meaning: Whether color makes the source worth inspecting for young stars. This column cannot assign the physical review flag by itself.

review_columns.name: star_forming_visual_evidence
review_columns.meaning: Whether visual inspection shows association with visible star-forming structure or irregular compact emission.

review_columns.name: possible_star_forming_region_or_young_cluster
review_columns.meaning: Combined review flag. Yes requires a catalog association or visual evidence; color alone is never sufficient.

review_columns.name: gaia_image_measurement_warning
review_columns.meaning: A separate Gaia-based warning that can prioritize visual review. It cannot assign the visual blend or image-problem flag.

review_columns.name: blend_or_image_problem_visual_evidence
review_columns.meaning: Visual evidence for overlapping or nearby sources, multiple peaks, asymmetry, position mismatch, saturation, boundaries, or artifacts.

review_columns.name: possible_nearby_source_blend_or_image_problem
review_columns.meaning: Visual-inspection flag; it cannot be assigned from Gaia measurements alone.

review_columns.name: visual_review_note
review_columns.meaning: Short evidence note supporting any visual flag or uncertainty.

review_columns.name: visual_reviewer
review_columns.meaning: Person or process responsible for the visual assessment.

review_columns.name: visual_reviewed_at_utc
review_columns.meaning: Time of visual assessment so later revisions remain traceable.
